description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Memoize::YAML, which implements a class to store memoized data in a YAML file by tying a hash. It provides methods for hash operations and manages loading from and saving to a YAML file. It includes documentation about usage, dependencies, and behavior.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Memoize::YAML
classes.description: A class to tie a hash to a YAML file for caching memoized data.

methods.name: TIEHASH
methods.description: Constructor that loads the YAML file into a hash or initializes an empty hash if the file doesn't exist.

methods.name: STORE
methods.description: Stores a value into the hash for a given key.

methods.name: FETCH
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the hash for a given key.

methods.name: EXISTS
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the hash.

methods.name: DESTROY
methods.description: Writes the hash back to the YAML file when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: SCALAR
methods.description: Returns the number of key-value pairs in the hash.

methods.name: FIRSTKEY
methods.description: Returns a placeholder string for the first hash key.

methods.name: NEXTKEY
methods.description: Returns undef, as iteration is not supported.
